findings.summary: closeDb only ends the singleton pool; tests using createDb(testPool) cannot dispose their own pool via this helper
findings.suggested_fix: Either drop closeDb and require callers to pass their pool to a closeDb(pool: Pool) form, or document closeDb as singleton-only and add a separate closePool(pool) helper for DI callers

findings.summary: createSessionToken/verifySessionToken accept arbitrary secret strings; 32-byte minimum is only enforced at env boundary
findings.suggested_fix: Add a guard at the top of secretKey(): if (secret.length < 32) throw new Error('JWT secret must be at least 32 bytes') — defends against any caller bypassing env

findings.summary: task-db-setup and task-auth-tokens have empty verification.build despite touching non-test source; verification-gates §Schema requires non-empty build
findings.suggested_fix: Planner: add `pnpm --filter @medbridge/api build` (or tsc --noEmit) to both tasks' verification.build so TS compile errors surface at task time, not at wave-smoke

findings.summary: DATABASE_URL silently falls back to empty string; drizzle-kit will produce a less actionable connect-time error when the env is unset
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `process.env.DATABASE_URL ?? ''` with an explicit guard: if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL required for drizzle-kit'); — preserves CLI-time fail-fast without coupling to loadEnv()

findings.summary: hashRefreshToken is async but performs only synchronous createHash work; Promise wrapper adds no value
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the async modifier — return createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex') directly. If the Promise<string> signature is part of a frozen contract, leave a comment explaining why

findings.summary: tokens.ts (alongside passwords.ts) sits outside the canonical module file set (routes/service/repo/schema/dto/index) per ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3
findings.suggested_fix: Acceptable as module-internal helpers; if precedent sticks, extend ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3 to permit named helper files alongside the canonical layered files
